reviews.review_description: the only thing you should be warned about for this app is that it requires a lot of space. after launching it downloads a few more things, presumably for the big videos in it. but the journey is fun and thoughtful and it asks us a lot of very important questions about our future relationship with ai technology. i also love the visuals in this!
The experience needs to download video files but I tried multiple times and it gets stuck around 26% on each occasion.
